screenshots.caption: See net worth, growth, allocation, and member-level insights in one clear portfolio view.
Manage confirmed member-owned assets with calculated values, flexible filters, and export tools.
Review each scheduled investment before updating holdings, then retain a clear confirmed transaction history.
Maintain reusable asset definitions, prices, rate sources, and allocation targets in one organized library.
Investigate category mix, gains, CAGR, and XIRR across confirmed portfolio records.
Set financial goals, calculate a FIRE target, and track progress and funding gaps.
Compare SIP, SWP, deposit, loan, return, and projection scenarios with calculators that run locally.
Optionally calculate Zakat, monitor payment progress, and organize payments, payees, and distribution.
